definitions.altered_regions_run25[].explained_by_wri: the region overlaps a block whose translation is written (necessary, not sufficient, for an intended change)
definitions.attempted_chars: expected characters for which the run produced a target
definitions.expected_chars: source characters of blocks in translation scope, recomputed with ONE rule for every run (language evidence, not the run's own label)
definitions.mask_spill: original dark pixels (gray < 140, zoom 3) no longer dark in the candidate, OUTSIDE the boxes of the run's TRANSLATED blocks, grouped in 8-connected clusters of >= 12 px: erased rules, underlines, neighbour glyphs (lower is better; run24 vs run25 only, same output format)
definitions.ocr_unreliable_sub_reasons: breakdown of UNCERTAIN:ocr_unreliable blocks by engine sub-reason (low_confidence_ocr = historical is_unreliable_ocr rule, low OCR confidence + text heuristics; bidi_number_order_unreliable = multi-group number read in a right-to-left context, kept as original image; checkbox_* = check-box readings)
definitions.partial_chars / absent_chars: attempted characters found PARTIAL / ABSENT in the rendered PDF
definitions.render.words_colliding: inserted words overlapping another inserted word
definitions.strict_coverage_model: historical 09/10 definition (translated / need, every untranslated non-French block counted missing whatever the reason) corresponds here to coverage_attempted; written strict coverage corresponds to coverage_written. Denominator rule differs from the 09/10 tool: 09/10 values are NOT comparable
definitions.untranslated_classification: every block not TRANSLATED in run25, mapped from its engine status:reason to the five categories of the run25 brief
definitions.visual_regions.altered: candidate graphic regions whose pixel change share vs original > 2 %
definitions.written_chars: expected characters whose target is found WRITTEN in the rendered PDF (independent text extraction)
